item.description:
Data Pipeline

Requirements

  • data processing job work just-in-time
  • design should be a scalable solutions
  • data consistency and syncronization
  • common module thinking
  • need some friendly integration
  • continuously review
  • create data pipeline SLA
  • dependency and flow
  • high availability

Design

  • relation database
  • hot & cold data layer
  • raw data and aggregation tier
  • data migration plan
  • data TTL & lifecycle

How to

  • Application
    • data producer & consumer
    • data model and governance
    • schema migration framework
  • Kafka
    • steaming data processing
  • PostgreSQL
    • master data storage
    • ACID
  • Clickhouse
    • multiple mergeTree table engine
    • materialized view
    • user defined function
  • ETL tools:
    • Airflow
    • Spark
